title: GitLab Routable personal access token: one-property twin (length)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: a 1-character version field vs exactly 2 base36 characters (CRC recomputed), length: a 26-character payload vs the documented minimum 27 (length holder and CRC recomputed), and length: the base36 payload-length holder claims one more character than the payload carries (CRC recomputed, so only the holder is wrong). Twin of "GitLab Routable personal access token: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of gitlab-routable-personal-access-token-export: length: the base36 payload-length holder claims one more character than the payload carries (CRC recomputed, so only the holder is wrong). Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
